heading.en: The kingdom passes from one to another by descent, intrigue, and murder—Emer saw the Son of Righteousness—Many prophets cry repentance—A famine and poisonous serpents plague the people.
heading.sm: E faasolo atu le malo mai le tasi i le isi e ala i le gafa, togafiti, ma le fasioti tagata—Sa vaai Emera i le Atalii o le Amiotonu—E toatele perofeta ua latou alaga atu le salamo—Ua malaia tagata i se oge ma gata uogo.

verses.en: And now I, Moroni, proceed with my record. Therefore, behold, it came to pass that because of the secret combinations of Akish and his friends, behold, they did overthrow the kingdom of Omer.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei o a’u, o Moronae, ou te faasolo atu i la’u talafaamaumau. O lea, faauta, ona o faalapotopotoga faalilolilo a Akiso ma ana uo, faauta, sa oo ai ina latou faatoilaloina le malo o Omera.

verses.en: Nevertheless, the Lord was merciful unto Omer, and also to his sons and to his daughters who did not seek his destruction.
verses.sm: Ae ui i lea, sa alofa mutimutivale le Alii ia Omera, ma ona atalii foi ma ona afafine o e sa latou le saili lona faaumatiaga.

verses.en: And the Lord warned Omer in a dream that he should depart out of the land; wherefore Omer departed out of the land with his family, and traveled many days, and came over and passed by the hill of Shim, and came over by the place where the Nephites were destroyed, and from thence eastward, and came to a place which was called Ablom, by the seashore, and there he pitched his tent, and also his sons and his daughters, and all his household, save it were Jared and his family.
verses.sm: Ma sa lapata’ia Omera e le Alii i se miti e tatau ona ia alu ese atu mai le laueleele; o le mea lea na alu ese atu ai Omera faatasi ma lona aiga mai le laueleele, ma malaga i aso e tele, ma o a’e ma ui ane i tafatafa o le maupu’epu’e o Semi, ma o mai i tafatafa ane o le nofoaga lea sa faaumatia ai sa Nifaē, ma mai iina i sasae, ma o atu i se nofoaga sa ta’ua o Apeloma, i tala ane o le apitaogalu, ma o iina na ia faatu ai lona faleie, ma ona atalii foi ma ona afafine, ma lona auaiga uma, vagana ai Iareto ma lona aiga.

verses.en: And it came to pass that Jared was anointed king over the people, by the hand of wicked– ness; and he gave unto Akish his daughter to wife.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina faauuina Iareto o se tupu i luga o le nuu, e le lima o le amioleaga; ma tuu atu ia Akiso lona afafine e fai ma ana avā.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And it came to pass that Akish sought the life of his father– in– law; and he applied unto those whom he had sworn by the oath of the ancients, and they obtained the head of his father– in– law, as he sat upon his throne, giving audience to his people.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina saili e Akiso le ola o le tamā o lana avā; ma sa ia talanoa atu ia i latou o ē na ia faatautoina i le tautoga a tagata anamua, ma sa latou vavae ese mai le ulu o le tamā o lana avā, a’o nofo o ia i luga o lona nofoalii, a’o alo faafofoga atu i ona tagata.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: For so great had been the spreading of this wicked and secret society that it had corrupted the hearts of all the people; therefore Jared was murdered upon his throne, and Akish reigned in his stead.
verses.sm: Ona sa matuā tele lava le sosolo o lenei sosaiete amioleaga ma faalilolilo sa faaleaga ai loto o tagata uma; o lea na fasiotia ai Iareto i luga o lona nofoalii, ma nofotupu ai Akiso i lona tulaga.

verses.en: And it came to pass that Akish began to be jealous of his son, therefore he shut him up in prison, and kept him upon little or no food until he had suffered death.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina amata ona fuā Akiso i lona atalii, o lea na ia lokaina ai o ia i le falepuipui, ma tausi o ia i nai meaai itiiti po o le leai foi seia oo ina mafatia o ia i le oti.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And now the brother of him that suffered death, (and his name was Nimrah) was angry with his father because of that which his father had done unto his brother.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei o le uso o ia lē na mafatia i le oti, (ma o lona igoa o Nimara) sa ita i lona tamā ona o lena mea na faia e lona tamā i lona uso.

verses.en: And it came to pass that Nimrah gathered together a small number of men, and fled out of the land, and came over and dwelt with Omer.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina faapotopoto e Nimara se aofai toaitiiti o tagata, ma sosola ese mai le laueleele, ma sa o a’e ma ua nonofo faatasi ma Omera.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And it came to pass that Akish begat other sons, and they won the hearts of the people, notwithstanding they had sworn unto him to do all manner of iniquity according to that which he desired.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina fanauina e Akiso isi atalii, ma sa fiafia le nuu ia te i latou, e ui ina sa latou tauto ia te ia o le a latou faia uiga amioletonu eseese uma e tusa ma mea sa manao i ai o ia.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: Now the people of Akish were desirous for gain, even as Akish was desirous for power; wherefore, the sons of Akish did offer them money, by which means they drew away the more part of the people after them.
verses.sm: O lenei sa mananao tagata o Akiso i ’oa, e pei ona manao Akiso i le pule; o le mea lea, na tuu atu ai ia te i latou e atalii o Akiso o tupe, o se ala lea na latou faatosina ese atu ai le vaega tele o tagata ia mulimuli atu ia te i latou.

w.en: the greater part of the people

verses.en: And there began to be a war between the sons of Akish and Akish, which lasted for the space of many years, yea, unto the destruction of nearly all the people of the kingdom, yea, even all, save it were thirty souls, and they who fled with the house of Omer.
verses.sm: Ma sa amata ona i ai o se taua i le va o atalii o Akiso ma Akiso, lea sa faia mo le va o tausaga e tele, ioe, seia oo ina toetoe a faaumatia ai tagata uma o le malo, ioe, tagata uma lava, vagana ai ni tagata e tolusefulu, ma i latou o ē na sosola faatasi ma le aiga o Omera.

w.en: all the people of the kingdom,

verses.en: Wherefore, Omer was restored again to the land of his inheritance.
verses.sm: O le mea lea na toefuatai ai Omera i le laueleele o lona tofi.

verses.en: And it came to pass that Omer began to be old; nevertheless, in his old age he begat Emer; and he anointed Emer to be king to reign in his stead.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina amata ona toeaina o Omera; ae ui i lea, sa fanauina e ia Emera i tausaga o lona toeaina; ma sa ia faauuina Emera e avea ma tupu e nofo e suitulaga ia te ia.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And after that he had anointed Emer to be king he saw peace in the land for the space of two years, and he died, having seen exceedingly many days, which were full of sorrow. And it came to pass that Emer did reign in his stead, and did fill the steps of his father.
verses.sm: Ma ina ua uma ona ia faauuina o Emera e avea ma tupu sa vaai o ia i le filemu i le laueleele mo le va o le lua tausaga, ma oti ai o ia, ina ua mavae ona vaai i le tele o aso, ia sa tumu i le faanoanoa. Ma sa oo ina nofo Emera e suitulaga ia te ia, ma sa mulimuli o ia i tulaga o lona tamā.

w.en: And it came to pass that
in the ways of his father.

verses.en: And the Lord began again to take the curse from off the land, and the house of Emer did prosper exceedingly under the reign of Emer; and in the space of sixty and two years they had become exceedingly strong, insomuch that they became exceedingly rich—
verses.sm: Ma sa toe amata ona aveese e le Alii le fetuu mai le laueleele, ma sa manuia tele lava le aiga o Emera i lalo o le nofoaiga a Emera; ma i le va o le ono sefulu ma le lua o tausaga sa avea i latou ma ni tagata malolosi tele, sa oo ina latou matuā mauoa lava—

verses.en: Having all manner of fruit, and of grain, and of silks, and of fine linen, and of gold, and of silver, and of precious things;
verses.sm: Sa latou maua fualaau aina eseese, ma saito, ma silika, ma lino lelei, ma le auro, ma le ario, ma mea taua.

verses.en: And also all manner of cattle, of oxen, and cows, and of sheep, and of swine, and of goats, and also many other kinds of animals which were useful for the food of man.
verses.sm: Ma ituaiga eseese uma o povi, o povi po’a, ma povi fafine, ma mamoe, ma meatuaolō, ma ’oti, ma isi ituaiga o manu e tele sa aoga mo meaai a tagata.

verses.en: And they also had horses, and asses, and there were elephants and cureloms and cumoms; all of which were useful unto man, and more especially the elephants and cureloms and cumoms.
verses.sm: Ma sa i ai foi ia te i latou o solofanua, ma asini, ma sa i ai elefane ma kureloma ma kumoma; o ni mea uma ia sa aoga i le tagata, ma aemaise lava elefane ma kureloma ma kumoma.

verses.en: And thus the Lord did pour out his blessings upon this land, which was choice above all other lands; and he commanded that whoso should possess the land should possess it unto the Lord, or they should be destroyed when they were ripened in iniquity; for upon such, saith the Lord: I will pour out the fulness of my wrath.
verses.sm: Ma sa faapea ona liligi ifo e le Alii ana faamanuiaga i luga o lenei laueleele, lea sa silisili ona lelei i luga o isi laueleele uma; ma sa ia poloaiina soo se tasi na te mauaina le laueleele e tatau ona ia mauaina mo le Alii, a leai o le a faaumatia i latou pe a latou matua i le amioletonu; ona o luga o i latou faapea, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii: O le a ou sasaa atu i ai le atoatoa o lo’u ita.

verses.en: And Emer did execute judgment in righteousness all his days, and he begat many sons and daughters; and he begat Coriantum, and he anointed Coriantum to reign in his stead.
verses.sm: Ma sa fai e Emera faamasinoga i le amiotonu i ona aso uma, ma sa fanauina e ia atalii ma afafine e toatele; ma sa fanauina e ia Korianetumu, ma sa ia faauuina Korianetumu e suitulaga ia te ia.

verses.en: And after he had anointed Coriantum to reign in his stead he lived four years, and he saw peace in the land; yea, and he even saw the Son of Righteousness, and did rejoice and glory in his day; and he died in peace.
verses.sm: Ma ina ua uma ona faauu e ia Korianetumu e suitulaga ia te ia, sa soifua o ia i tausaga e fa, ma sa vaai o ia i le filemu i le laueleele; ioe, ma sa vaai lava o ia i le Atalii o le Amiotonu, ma sa olioli ma vivii e uiga i ona aso; ma sa maliu filemu o ia.

verses.en: And it came to pass that Coriantum did walk in the steps of his father, and did build many mighty cities, and did administer that which was good unto his people in all his days. And it came to pass that he had no children even until he was exceedingly old.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina savali Korianetumu i tulaga o lona tamā, ma ia fausia aai tetele e tele, ma faia i lona nuu mea lelei i ona aso uma. Ma sa oo ina sa leai sana fanau seia oo ina toeaina lava o ia.

w.en: And it came to pass that
in the ways of his father,
And it came to pass that

verses.en: And it came to pass that his wife died, being an hundred and two years old. And it came to pass that Coriantum took to wife, in his old age, a young maid, and begat sons and daughters; wherefore he lived until he was an hundred and forty and two years old.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina maliu lana avā, ina ua selau ma le lua ona tausaga. Ma sa oo ina ave e Korianetumu e fai ma ana avā, ina ua toeaina o ia, se tamaitai talavou, ma fanauina ai ni atalii ma afafine; o le mea lea sa soifua ai o ia seia oo i le selau fa sefulu ma le lua tausaga o lona soifua.

w.en: And it came to pass that
And it came to pass that

verses.en: And it came to pass that he begat Com, and Com reigned in his stead; and he reigned forty and nine years, and he begat Heth; and he also begat other sons and daughters.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina fanauina e ia Komi, ma sa nofo Komi e suitulaga ia te ia; ma sa nofotupu o ia i tausaga e fa sefulu ma le iva, ma sa fanauina ai e ia Hetu; ma sa ia fanauina foi ni isi atalii ma afafine.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And the people had spread again over all the face of the land, and there began again to be an exceedingly great wickedness upon the face of the land, and Heth began to embrace the secret plans again of old, to destroy his father.
verses.sm: Ma sa toe salalau atu le nuu i luga o le laueleele atoa, ma sa toe amata ona i ai o le amioleaga tele i luga o le laueleele, ma sa amata e Hetu ona toe opogi o fuafuaga faalilolilo mai anamua, e faaumatia ai lona tamā.

verses.en: And it came to pass that he did dethrone his father, for he slew him with his own sword; and he did reign in his stead.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina aveese e ia lona tamā mai le nofoalii, auā sa ia fasioti ia te ia i lana lava pelu; ma sa nofo o ia e suitulaga ia te ia.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And there came prophets in the land again, crying repentance unto them—that they must prepare the way of the Lord or there should come a curse upon the face of the land; yea, even there should be a great famine, in which they should be destroyed if they did not repent.
verses.sm: Ma sa i ai perofeta sa toe o mai i le laueleele, ma alaga mai le salamo ia te i latou— e faapea e ao ina latou teuteu le ala o le Alii a leai o le a oo mai se fetuu i luga o le laueleele; ioe, o le a oo mai lava se oge tele, lea o le a faaumatia ai i latou pe afai latou te le salamo.

verses.en: But the people believed not the words of the prophets, but they cast them out; and some of them they cast into pits and left them to perish. And it came to pass that they did all these things according to the commandment of the king, Heth.
verses.sm: Peitai sa le talitonu tagata i upu a perofeta, ae sa latou tutuli i latou i fafo; ma o ni isi o i latou sa latou lafo i totonu o lua ma tuu i latou ia fano ai. Ma sa oo ina latou faia nei mea uma e tusa ma le poloaiga a le tupu, o Hetu.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And it came to pass that there began to be a great dearth upon the land, and the inhabitants began to be destroyed exceedingly fast because of the dearth, for there was no rain upon the face of the earth.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina amata ona i ai o se oge tele i luga o le laueleele, ma sa amata ona faaumatia vave lava tagata ona o le oge, ona ua leai se timu i luga o le fogaeleele.

w.en: And it came to pass that
upon the face of the earth.

verses.en: And there came forth poisonous serpents also upon the face of the land, and did poison many people. And it came to pass that their flocks began to flee before the poisonous serpents, towards the land southward, which was called by the Nephites Zarahemla.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo mai foi gata uogo i luga o le laueleele, ma ūtia oona ai tagata e toatele. Ma sa oo ina amata ona sosola ese a latou lafu mai gata uogo, e agai atu i le laueleele i saute, lea sa ta’ua e sa Nifaē o Sara’emila.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And it came to pass that there were many of them which did perish by the way; nevertheless, there were some which fled into the land southward.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina fano le tele o i latou i le ala; ae ui i lea, e i ai ni isi sa sosola atu i le laueleele i saute.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And it came to pass that the Lord did cause the serpents that they should pursue them no more, but that they should hedge up the way that the people could not pass, that whoso should attempt to pass might fall by the poisonous serpents.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina faia e le Alii ia le toe tuliloaina i latou e gata uogo, ae ia latou punitia le ala ina ia le mafai e tagata ona ui atu ai, ma po o ai lava e taumafai e ui atu ai e mafai ai ona ūtia o’ona e gata uogo.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And it came to pass that the people did follow the course of the beasts, and did devour the carcasses of them which fell by the way, until they had devoured them all. Now when the people saw that they must perish they began to repent of their iniquities and cry unto the Lord.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina mulimuli atu tagata i le ala o manu, ma aai i tino o manu na pa’u’ū i le ala, seia oo ina latou faaaogaina uma i latou. O lenei ina ua vaai tagata o le a latou fano sa amata ona latou salamo i a latou amioletonu ma tagi atu i le Alii.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And it came to pass that when they had humbled themselves sufficiently before the Lord he did send rain upon the face of the earth; and the people began to revive again, and there began to be fruit in the north countries, and in all the countries round about. And the Lord did show forth his power unto them in preserving them from famine.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina ua lava lo latou faalotomaualalaloina o i latou lava i luma o le Alii sa ia auina ifo i le timu i luga o le fogaeleele; ma sa amata ona toe faamalolosia tagata, ma sa amata ona i ai o fualaau aina i laufanua i matu, ma laufanua uma o faataamilo ai. Ma sa faaali mai e le Alii lona mana ia te i latou i le faasaoina lea o i latou mai le oge.

w.en: upon the face of the earth;
